authority_policy: The Sol pack is an implementation hypothesis. Current repository code, canonical K4/K4.1 artifacts, and pinned local source evidence are authoritative.

findings.local_evidence: The baseline living projection hard-coded right-facing wait/typing output.
findings.resolution: V8LiveRuntime and direction.ts project the prompt-authoritative raw 0/1/2/3 left/right/down/up mapping and selector tables.

findings.local_evidence: Baseline LivingRuntime retained talk visual events but not the selected canonical Fukidashi payload.
findings.resolution: V8 fukidashi state stores semantic ID, lifetime, delay, offsetY, source, and English localization with native guards.

findings.local_evidence: Baseline invitation arrival moved directly into stand-talking without a visual invitation timeline.
findings.resolution: V8LiveRuntime adds frame-20 opening and frame-60 response/busy projection on top of the unchanged canonical living runtime.

findings.local_evidence: Baseline equipment behavior emitted traces but did not project the exact frame-20/40/60 selector cadence.
findings.resolution: V8 projects the source-backed 7/8, 15/16, and 11/12 selector phases and keeps frame-70 completion in LivingRuntime.

findings.local_evidence: Baseline FADE flags existed, but audited runtime output did not expose the native alpha progression and hidden-state guard.
findings.resolution: V8 applies the source +25/-25 alpha cadence, keeps WAIT_BACK_OF_DOOR hidden, and makes the Room.AddStaff alpha-zero bootstrap visible through the live entry path.

findings.local_evidence: The generic furniture and actor paths could not express K4.1 type-2 nested Staff ordering or suppress duplicate Staff draws.
findings.resolution: The V8 command compiler and workstation compiler encode both raw direction 2 and raw direction 3 native interleaves through preview=false ownership.

findings.local_evidence: The baseline renderer retained pass labels while using comparison-view merged underlay/wall operations for the display path.
findings.resolution: The Room0 V8 branch owns the nine pass identities, underlay-first order, native row traversal, live nested workstations, and final visibility diagnostics.

findings.local_evidence: The baseline default renderer contained route/ring diagnostics, fallback actor markers, and a talk-frame placeholder.
findings.resolution: The V8 Room0 compositor uses full catalog character assets and localized Fukidashi payloads; route/ring/raw diagnostics remain opt-in or outside the V8 branch.

findings.local_evidence: The accepted bounded display manifest exposed only wait/typing actors and froze floor00 furniture frame 0.
findings.resolution: V8 lazily resolves the full character selector catalog and composes source-backed live FurnitureData subframes without expanding the accepted static manifest.
